title: AGENTVERSE: Facilitating Multi-Agent Collaboration and Exploring Emergent Behaviors in Agents

defines.name: AGENTVERSE
defines.definition: A general multi-agent framework that simulates human group problem-solving with dynamic agent recruitment, collaboration, execution, and evaluation.

problem: Existing multi-agent systems are limited to narrow tasks and static agent roles, which restricts their generalizability and adaptability in complex real-world problem solving.
